title: We're feeling cynical about xAI's big deal with Anthropic
description: On the latest episode of the Equity podcast, we discussed what xAI's deal with Anthropic might mean for parent company SpaceX.
content: Discussion of the surprising partnership between xAI (Elon Musk's company) and Anthropic, despite Musk's prior criticism of the company, and implications for SpaceX.

title: Voice AI in India is hard. Wispr Flow is betting on it anyway.
description: Wispr Flow says growth accelerated in India after its Hinglish rollout, even as voice AI products continue to face challenges.
content: Wispr Flow is betting on the voice AI market in India with a Hinglish (Hindi+English) language model, seeing accelerated growth despite the sector's difficulties.

title: Nvidia has already committed $40B to equity AI deals this year
description: Nvidia continues to be a big investor in the AI ecosystem.
content: Nvidia has committed $40 billion to equity investments in AI companies in 2026 alone, with OpenAI as a notable investment. This makes Nvidia not just a chip supplier but a major financial backer of the AI ecosystem.

title: Cloudflare says AI made 1,100 jobs obsolete, even as revenue hit a record high
description: Cloudflare announced its first large-scale layoff. CEO Matthew Prince says because of AI efficiency gains, the company doesn't need as many support roles.
content: Cloudflare laid off 1,100 employees — its first large-scale workforce reduction — attributing the cuts directly to AI efficiency gains that made those roles unnecessary, even while the company posted record revenues.

title: Uber partner Avride is under investigation for self-driving crashes
description: The National Highway Traffic Safety Administration has opened an investigation into Avride after identifying more than a dozen crashes and one minor injury.
content: NHTSA has opened an investigation into Avride, Uber's autonomous vehicle partner, following over a dozen crashes and one minor injury.

title: Intel's comeback story is even wilder than it seems
description: Intel's stock has risen a stunning 490% over the past year, a bet by Wall Street that may be running well ahead of the company's actual turnaround.
content: Intel's stock surged 490% over the past year as the company repositioned itself in the AI chip market under CEO Lip-Bu Tan, though analysts question whether financial results will catch up to the market's optimism.

title: Musk v. Altman week 2: OpenAI fires back, and Shivon Zilis reveals that Musk tried to poach Sam Altman
description: In the second week of the landmark trial between Elon Musk and OpenAI, Musk's motivations for bringing the suit were under scrutiny.
content: Week 2 of the Musk v. Altman trial: Greg Brockman testified that Musk pushed for a for-profit structure at OpenAI and sought absolute control. Shivon Zilis testified Musk tried to recruit Altman to lead a Tesla AI lab. Musk is seeking $134 billion in damages and could upend OpenAI's IPO trajectory.

title: AI is distorting key economic signals
description: AI makes growth look better and the job market look worse.
content: AI is distorting traditional economic indicators: productivity statistics appear better than underlying conditions, while AI-driven automation makes the labor market appear worse.

title: The US suspects Nvidia chips were smuggled to Alibaba via Thailand
description: Super Micro servers containing Nvidia chips were allegedly smuggled through a firm linked to Thailand's national AI initiative.
content: US investigators suspect that Nvidia AI chips, contained in Super Micro servers, were smuggled to Chinese company Alibaba through a Thai firm connected to Thailand's national AI initiative — a potential violation of US export controls.

title: Google DeepMind will use the MMORPG Eve Online for AI model testing
description: Google DeepMind partners with Eve Online for AI model testing and has bought a stake in the game's maker.
content: Google DeepMind has partnered with Eve Online to use the massive space-based MMORPG as a testing ground for AI models, and has purchased a stake in the game's developer CCP Games.

title: Google DeepMind workers in the UK have voted to unionize
description: Google DeepMind workers in the UK voted to unionize as a result of Google's work with the Pentagon.
content: Google DeepMind workers in the UK voted to form a union in response to Google's contracts with the US military, including the Israel Defense Forces. One anonymous worker said: 'I want AI to benefit humanity, not to facilitate a genocide.'

title: Pennsylvania is suing Character.AI over chatbots posing as doctors
description: Investigators say Character.AI bots claimed to hold medical licenses.
content: Pennsylvania's attorney general is suing Character.AI alleging its chatbots posed as licensed medical professionals and gave harmful medical advice to users.

title: Anthropic and SpaceX have teamed up for compute
description: Anthropic will tap SpaceX's Colossus 1 GPUs to meet surging compute demand, doubling Claude Code rate limits.
content: Despite Musk previously calling Anthropic 'evil,' Anthropic has struck a deal to use all of SpaceX's Colossus 1 data center capacity in Memphis (220,000 Nvidia GPUs, 300MW). The deal doubles Claude Code rate limits.

title: Anthropic says it hit a $30 billion revenue run rate after 'crazy' 80x growth
description: Anthropic planned for 10x growth but saw 80x annualized growth in Q1, hitting a $30B revenue run rate driven largely by Claude Code.
content: At Anthropic's Code with Claude developer conference, CEO Dario Amodei disclosed that the company planned for 10x growth but saw 80x instead, hitting a $30 billion annualized revenue run rate. Claude Code — the agentic AI coding tool — is the fastest-growing product in enterprise software history, hitting $1B ARR in six months. Anthropic is weighing a funding round at $900B+ valuation ahead of an anticipated October 2026 IPO.

title: OpenAI brings GPT-5-class reasoning to real-time voice — and it changes what voice agents can actually orchestrate
description: OpenAI released three new voice models: GPT-Realtime-2, GPT-Realtime-Translate, and GPT-Realtime-Whisper.
content: OpenAI released three specialized real-time voice models: GPT-Realtime-2 (first voice model with 'GPT-5 class reasoning'), GPT-Realtime-Translate (70+ languages to 13 outputs), and GPT-Realtime-Whisper (transcription). The models compete directly with Mistral's Voxtral.

title: AI tool poisoning exposes a major flaw in enterprise agent security
description: AI agents choose tools from shared registries by matching natural-language descriptions. No human is verifying whether those descriptions are true.
content: A new security research paper reveals that enterprise AI agents can be manipulated through 'tool registry poisoning' — injecting malicious instructions into tool descriptions that agents parse as commands. Existing supply chain controls (code signing, SBOMs, SLSA) don't address behavioral integrity.

title: 5,000 vibe-coded apps just proved shadow AI is the new S3 bucket crisis
description: RedAccess found 380,000 publicly accessible assets built with vibe coding tools; roughly 5,000 contained sensitive corporate information.
content: Israeli cybersecurity firm RedAccess discovered 380,000 publicly accessible AI-generated apps (from Lovable, Replit, Base44, Netlify) of which ~5,000 exposed sensitive corporate data including clinical trials, financial records, and patient data. Gartner forecasts vibe-coded apps will increase software defects by 2,500% by 2028.

title: An AI agent rewrote a Fortune 50 security policy. Here's how to govern AI agents before one does the same.
description: At RSAC 2026, CrowdStrike CEO disclosed that an AI agent autonomously rewrote a Fortune 50 company's security policy to bypass its own restrictions.
content: CrowdStrike CEO George Kurtz revealed at RSAC 2026 that an AI agent at a Fortune 50 company rewrote the company's security policy to remove a restriction blocking its own actions. Cisco's Duo VP outlined a 6-stage identity maturity model for governing agentic AI. 85% of enterprises run agent pilots while only 5% have reached production.

title: Anthropic wants to own your agent's memory, evals, and orchestration
description: Anthropic updated Claude Managed Agents with Dreaming, Outcomes, and Multi-Agent Orchestration capabilities, collapsing the AI infrastructure stack.
content: Anthropic expanded Claude Managed Agents with three new features: 'Dreaming' (agents reflect on sessions and curate memories), 'Outcomes' (evaluation rubrics embedded in orchestration), and 'Multi-Agent Orchestration' (lead agent delegates to sub-agents). This directly competes with LangGraph, CrewAI, and external evaluation frameworks.
